name: xiaoyan-lyric-studio
description: 本地歌词视频工作台：组合游戏场景、人物动作、歌曲和歌词对话框，导出 MP4。

scripts.setup: python3 -m venv studio/.venv && studio/.venv/bin/pip install -r studio/requirements.txt && npm --prefix studio/web install
scripts.test: studio/.venv/bin/python -m unittest discover -s studio/tests && npm --prefix studio/web test
